assets.creator: WORLDSEED Procedural Graphics Engine
assets.provenance: Original procedural surface compositor written for this project
assets.dimensions: 10 pixels per simulation tile (640x480 at the default 64x48 world)
assets.usage: Single authoritative planetary surface image: bilinear terrain interpolation, derived-normal hill shading, coastal strand, bathymetry, ice, deterministic micro-texture, rivers, lakes, roads, settlement footprints and ruin scatter. Consumed by both the 2D cartographic views and the Three.js hero views.

assets.creator: Platform font stacks (no bundled font files)
assets.license: N/A — system fonts are not redistributed
assets.provenance: ui-serif / ui-sans-serif / ui-monospace generic families with named platform fallbacks
assets.usage: Replaces the previous Google Fonts <link>, which was a required public network request and silently failed in the offline native macOS build.

policy.statement: Every visual byte WORLDSEED renders is generated by project code at runtime. No image, font, model, sprite sheet or texture is downloaded, bundled from a third party, or fetched from a network at runtime.
